title: 11 voice e2e specs fail at baseline on the dev console; data-testid="state" is used twice
evidence: npx playwright test -c tests/qa/pass4/pw.voice.config.ts (VOICE_SPECS='(vad|vadfake|bargein|hold|ambientrate|mode)\.spec'): 12 failed, 15 passed; docs/qa/pass4/evidence/voice-specs.json. hold.spec 'wait': strict mode violation, getByTestId('state') resolved to 2 elements (src/app/dev/thunai/Harness.tsx:112 and src/components/collector/app/thunai/Hud.tsx:162).
skeptic_why: No P0/P1 rows exist (this is medium). Repro needs /dev/thunai, which returns 404 on the production .next-qa build (port 3190), so hold.spec times out waiting for __jv (a different failure). Code read agrees with the claim: Harness.tsx:112 and Hud.tsx:162 both set data-testid=state, and Harness renders Thunai (Harness.tsx:116), so getByTestId(state) is ambiguous in dev. Severity medium looks fair for test-only breakage. The evidence string has an invalid JSON escape (backslash-dot) that makes the file unparseable by JSON.parse.

title: Sign-in over http://localhost does not stick in WebKit: session cookie is Secure
evidence: node tests/qa/pass4/voice-browsers.webkit-ui-login.mjs (login form, WebKit): POST /api/auth/login 200 then GET /api/auth/me 401, user stays on /login?redirect=%2Fcitizen; Chromium on the same steps gets 200 and /citizen. Cookies are secure=true. Likely only a local-development issue (plain http); not tested on https.
skeptic_why: Severity low, not P0/P1. Re-run of the webkit-ui-login script on 3190 got 401 on POST /api/auth/login in both WebKit and Chromium: the citizenA account is not seeded on this server, so the claim could not be reproduced. Code read: session-cookies.ts:47 sets secure only when NODE_ENV=production, consistent with the claim (WebKit rejects Secure cookies on plain http; Chromium exempts localhost). Low severity is fair.
